text:
maya: Hey folks — can someone take a quick look at PR #8773? It's a concurrency tweak in the REST client that prevents occasional head-of-queue stalls under high QPS. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8773

jon: On it :eyes: I'll skim the diff now.

jon: Quick note — the change moves a push to the front of the queue for single-item batches. Seems small but could change ordering semantics.

maya: Correct, this is targeted at the LIFO fallback we hit when batcher drains with 1-item batches. I added a unit test and an e2e that repro'd the stall.

tia: Does this touch streaming/toolcall ordering? We rely on FIFO for streaming chunks in some paths.

maya: Good question. The change only affects the internal short-circuit path when batch_size==1 and batching disabled. Streaming code path is untouched; added an explicit test for toolcall streaming to ensure order preserved.

sam: CI shows one flaky: test_batcher_timeout on mac runners. Failing on the timing assertion.

jon: I can rerun the job. If flaky, we should relax the timing window or mock clock.

maya: Opened a follow-up to use freezegun in that test if we need it. For this PR I bumped the timeout to 2s and added a deterministic seed — tests pass locally.

sam: Rerun triggered — GH action queued.

merge-bot: CI workflow #build-and-test (commit 4f2a9b1) queued.

jon: Reviewed the code — left one tiny nit (naming) and one suggestion to add an inline comment explaining why push_front is safe here. Otherwise LGTM.

maya: Thanks — pushed a fixup for the nit and comment.

merge-bot: CI workflow #build-and-test (commit 6c8f1d4) passed.

tia: :thumbsup: I ran the streaming smoke locally against canary and verified ordering unchanged.

sam: Approved on GH.

jon: Approved.

maya: Thanks all — merging after a short buffer to let autopreview propagate. If anything breaks, we can revert quickly.

merge-bot: Merged PR #8773 into main (commit 6c8f1d4).
